samplingMethod: Five deterministic difficulty-2 instances per approved generator, produced from the checked-in generator source.

samples.questionText: A box of 7 apples costs $469. What is the unit rate in dollars per apple?
samples.questionLatex: A box of 7 apples costs $469. What is the unit rate in dollars per apple?
solutionSteps: Unit rate = total ÷ number of units.

audit.announcedSkill: Solve a missing value in a ratio table

samples.questionText:
Find the missing value in the ratio table:

x | y
1 | 5
4 | 20
12 | ?
samples.questionLatex:
Find the missing value in the ratio table:

$$\begin{array}{c|c}
\text{x} & \text{y} \\ \hline
1 & 5 \\
4 & 20 \\
12 & ?
\end{array}$$
solutionSteps: Find the constant of proportionality: y/x = 5.
